turns.text: Hi there! What answer did you get for Mark's weekly pay, and how did you get it?
I got $96. I did 8 hours times the new pay of $12.
Okay. What does that 8 hours tell us in the problem?
It's how many hours he works each day. I still think 96 is right though.
The question asks about how much he makes in what length of time?
Oh, a week. I only did one day, huh.
So how many hours does Mark work in a whole week?
Good. Now what is his hourly pay after the raise?
Um, $2? Wait, no, that's just the raise. It's 10 plus 2, so $12.
Nice catch. Using his weekly hours and that hourly pay, how could you find his weekly pay?
Why does multiplying the hours by the hourly pay give his weekly pay?
Because he gets $12 for every hour, so you add 12 for each of the 40 hours, and I forgot to count all the days at first.
